options.a: Prepare the treatment area and assist as the PT/PTA directs

options.a: Wrapping in one thin towel so heat reaches deeper tissue

options.a: Applied directly to skin for 45 minutes to cut swelling faster

options.a: Keep walking briskly to raise their blood pressure

options.a: Staying where you can control a fall

options.c: Walking ahead of the patient when going up

Stay below the patient: behind going up, in front going down.

options.a: Be pulled taut to keep it off the floor

options.a: Ask a coworker to talk you through it

options.a: Does not put that foot down

options.a: Optional

options.a: Hold the limbs still to stop the jerking

options.a: Are recapped by hand before disposal

options.a: Close the curtain or door as appropriate
